exploration.title: Pulumi to Alchemy
openQuestions: Target: no TypeScript 6 in infra/ (option C suffices) or no Pulumi (A, or B converging on A)?
Policy: new infrastructure Alchemy-first? Canonical Alchemy state store (Cloudflare store vs S3 lease state), and do the r2-cache stacks leave local state?
OIP hosting: stay on Vercel (Pulumi keeps opip-web, or Vercel config leaves IaC) or move apps/oip-web to Cloudflare Workers via OpenNext?
Retire the never-applied beep-storybook Pulumi program (and its Vercel project) now?
Runner fleet: keep the Terraform module on Pulumi indefinitely or schedule a replacement (GitHub-hosted runners vs Alchemy-native composite)?
Host stacks (AI metrics, OpenClaw): Pulumi, Alchemy custom resources, or the Effect CLI that already renders them?
Appetite for the credential-free option-C spike: compiled-JS pulumi preview with typescript:false plus a TS7-built ghaRunners SDK?
Account singletons (cost-allocation tags, Compute Optimizer / Cost Optimization Hub enrollments): thin custom resources or out of IaC into the cost runbook?
